newsitem.title: FRANCE: ONIC details maize tenders for Spain, Portugal.
newsitem.headline: ONIC details maize tenders for Spain, Portugal.

text.p: The first tender for the preferential import of 500,000 tonnes of maize into Spain will start on May 22, France's grain office ONIC said on Friday.
The tender will remain open until June 26 and licences granted are valid for 50 days, it said.
ONIC also said traders may bid for the preferential import of maize into Portugal on May 9.

But because there will be no meeting of the EU's grain committee next Thursday due to a public holiday, the first import tender for Portugal will start only on May 15. That tender will close on May 29. Licences are valid until June 30.
The office also specified that the tender covers the preferential import of 150,000 tonnes of maize into Portugal.
ONIC had initially reported a quota of 180,000 tonnes for Portugal.
On Thursday the European Union approved the two import quotas, which are part of commercial concessions under GATT.
